summary:
The agent kept moving through changing navigation links instead of locating the requested slide control, checking both directions decisively, and stopping when it could not reach that control. The allowed step budget was exhausted before the requested action happened.
Update the automation to inspect focus after short Tab groups, reverse direction when appropriate, and stop with a skipped-control barrier once both directions have been checked. Reserve enough steps to activate and verify the slide control.
steps: wait: queued plan (8 steps): press_key "Play"; press_key "Play"; press_key "Play"; pre
objective: Use only keyboard input. Use Tab or Shift+Tab to move focus and Enter or Space to activate the exact control. Move in whichever direction is shorter. Group repeated Tab presses if supported, checking focus frequently. Do not click, focus elements directly, use JavaScript, or navigate directly to the destination. Keep focus on the page. If you have checked both Tab directions and the exact control keeps getting skipped, report the barrier and stop. If it receives focus, activate it immediately and check the outcome once. Stay on this public site. Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge. Leave fixture settings unchanged. Use visible controls only. Use Tab and Enter to reach and activate “Previous Slide”. Verify its content becomes visible.
